item.title: Microsoft is set to kill a confusing Outlook email feature — as the longstanding but unpopular tool had years of complaints
item.description: Microsoft is removing Contact Masking from Outlook on March 31, 2026, after years of user confusion. The feature, which hid suggested contacts across Microsoft 365 services, will disappear across desktop, mobile, and web.
